Morsegram lifts these limits on this device only. Nothing pretends that you have a subscription and no server reply is faked: these are limits the Telegram app decides by itself, not on its servers. They exist only in this sideloaded version, not in the Google Play one. Everything Telegram decides on its servers stays paid: uploads above 2 GB, server-side transcription, several reactions on one message, synced folders, stories, longer captions and bio, extra public links and usernames, paid privacy settings, name colour and emoji status.

Translating a whole conversation asks Telegram once per message: on a long chat the server can impose a wait, and translation then slows down or stops for a few minutes. Single-message translation is unaffected, and the Morsegram assistant can translate as well.
**Morsegram** needs access to your contacts so that you can connect with your friends across all your devices. Your contacts are synced with the heavily encrypted Telegram cloud servers.

With a provider outside the phone (Groq, Google Gemini) the four features (summary, translation, draft reply, search) send the text of your messages to a service that belongs neither to Morsegram nor to Telegram. Identifiers that can be recognised by their shape (phone numbers, emails, IBANs, card numbers, Italian tax codes, verification codes, links carrying a token) are replaced with placeholders before anything leaves; names and the rest of the text are not. In that configuration the assistant starts off, is turned on one chat at a time, and the first time you use it on a chat it shows you the exact text that would leave. With the model on this phone none of those three apply, because nothing leaves and there is no recipient to name: the assistant is there in every chat, there is no preview and no consent to give, and the text goes to Groq or Gemini only if you pick that provider for that one job, where the preview comes back. In neither case does it work on a hidden chat. Morsegram never sends a message by itself: a draft goes into the message box and you send it. Every answer can be reported from the window that shows it, and the reports stay on this phone.
